{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in channel
channels = sales['channel'].unique()
print("Unique channels:", channels)

# Check the status values
statuses = sales['status'].unique()
print("Unique statuses:", statuses)

# Check revenue column
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("First few revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
